notes.title: v0.915 – Major Update! New Features, Dialogs, Improvements
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619028/a85abcbcf6f3dcfceefceb44ffb80cc85e86a667.gif"][/img][/p][p]A major update has arrived for [i]It’s John’s House[/i]! Explore new anomalies, finalized voice-over, save points, and a swaying flashlight that heightens tension. Darker, more twisted dialogues and smarter AI make every encounter unpredictable. Updated rooms, hidden view points, and improved visuals bring the house’s horrors to life like never before.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Full Patch Notes – v0.915[/b][/p][p][b]🔹 New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Voice-over finalized[/b] – full narration now fully implemented[/p][/*][*][p][b]Save points[/b] – restart from the last room after death, making exploration less punishing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Swaying flashlight[/b] – adds more atmosphere (can be disabled in Settings)[/p][/*][*][p][b]View points[/b] – new locations where the player can pause and observe the environment[/p][/*][*][p][b]New anomalies[/b] – more creepy, mysterious events to discover[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔹 Gameplay & AI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Dialogues rewritten[/b] – darker, creepier, more twisted, and more emotional[/p][/*][*][p][b]Anomaly tooltips[/b] – now appear with a short delay; must keep the cursor on them to reveal[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death camera upgraded[/b] – more cinematic and unsettling[/p][/*][*][p][b]AI improvements[/b] – ghoul can now lurk, follow, and even open cabinets while searching[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🔹 Audio & Visuals[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Updated soundtrack[/b] – enhanced tension and atmosphere[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved visuals and room designs[/b] – more detail, better lighting, and rather story telling environments[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you for playing [i]It’s John’s House[/i]![/p][p]
This major update improves the experience for all players, whether you’re exploring the demo or diving into the full game. Your feedback shapes the world of John Revenwood, so keep sharing your thoughts in the Community Hub.[/p][p]- Patrik M.[/p]

notes.title: The Dark History Behind It’s John’s House
notes.notes:
[h3]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619028/4fbaa0ee8afb33532ace25f2a9e198cad39b205c.gif"][/img][/h3][h1]The Dark History Behind [i]It’s John’s House[/i][/h1][p]Dr John Ravenwood was once a successful lawyer with a happy family, living in Ravenwood Manor. But everything changed after a tragic accident... his daughter suffered a severe allergic reaction to peanut butter cookies made by John's mother, who also lived in the manor.[/p][p]Unable to save her, the family was shattered. John’s wife left, and the trauma caused John to lose his grip on reality. John's mother, overwhelmed by guilt and madness, was confined to a special room in the manor.[/p][p]Since then, people have been disappearing: police officers, neighbours, and those searching for the missing ones.[/p][p]You are one of these seekers, drawn into Ravenwood’s twisted games. But beware—each time a player dies, another arrives, caught in an endless cycle orchestrated by John himself.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619028/a95955cdf572d87a5910becdb68b18a1577dcc3f.jpg"][/img][i]“Who doesn’t like cookies?”[/i]
[/p][p]All the best,
Patrik[/p]
